req.title: Include origin IP in echoed metadata
req.statement: The system shall include the client origin (X-Forwarded-For if present, else remote_addr) in the 'origin' field of all echo endpoints.
triggers: include origin ip in echoed metadata

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must include the client origin IP in the 'origin' field, preferring X-Forwarded-For if present, else falling back to remote_addr. The key logic is in get_dict() in helpers.py: `origin=request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr)`. Tests must cover: (1) positive - remote_addr used when no X-Forwarded-For header, (2) positive - X-Forwarded-For header takes precedence over remote_addr, (3) negative - absence of origin field would be a failure, (4) boundary - X-Forwarded-For present but empty string vs. absent, (5) decision table covering all five endpoints, (6) multiple IPs in X-Forwarded-For chain. Mutation targets: the `get` vs `request.remote_addr` fallback, the header name string 'X-Forwarded-For', and the field name 'origin' in the response.

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '127.0.0.1'

test_get_origin_uses_remote_addr_when_no_xff()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_origin_prefers_x_forwarded_for_over_remote_addr():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '203.0.113.42'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == '203.0.113.42'
    assert data['origin'] != '127.0.0.1'

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For header set to known IP
actions: Send GET /get, POST /post, PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete each with X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.1
For each response assert status 200 and origin == '10.0.0.1'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: all echo endpoints /get /post /put /patch /delete must include origin
core.py: each view calls get_dict(..., 'origin', ...)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field():
    client = app.test_client()
    xff = '10.0.0.1'
    headers = {'X-Forwarded-For': xff}
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method, headers=headers)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} status={r.status_code}"
        data = json.loads(r.data)
        assert 'origin' in data, f"{method} {path} missing 'origin'"
        assert data['origin'] == xff, f"{method} {path} origin={data['origin']!r}"

test_all_echo_endpoints_include_origin_field()

tests.name: test_origin_uses_xff_chain_verbatim
preconditions: X-Forwarded-For header contains a comma-separated chain of IPs
actions: Assert origin equals the full chain string verbatim
expected: origin equals '192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.1' exactly (not just first IP)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-034: X-Forwarded-For value is used as-is from the header
helpers.py: request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', request.remote_addr) returns full header value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_origin_uses_xff_chain_verbatim():
    client = app.test_client()
    xff_chain = '192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.1'
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': xff_chain})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert data['origin'] == xff_chain
    assert data['origin'] != '192.168.1.1'
    assert data['origin'] != '127.0.0.1'

test_origin_uses_xff_chain_verbatim()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_patch_and_put_origin_with_xff():
    client = app.test_client()
    r_patch = client.patch('/patch', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '203.0.113.99'})
    assert r_patch.status_code == 200
    d_patch = json.loads(r_patch.data)
    assert 'origin' in d_patch
    assert d_patch['origin'] == '203.0.113.99'
    assert d_patch['origin'] != '127.0.0.1'

    r_put = client.put('/put', headers={'X-Forwarded-For': '203.0.113.88'})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    d_put = json.loads(r_put.data)
    assert 'origin' in d_put
    assert d_put['origin'] == '203.0.113.88'
    assert d_put['origin'] != '127.0.0.1'

test_patch_and_put_origin_with_xff()
